page.notes: The woodcut initial in the box at left is a P; the adjoining word is POST, so the initial is joined to "OST" as "POST". Greek in thesis 2 is uncertain at the word τῷ, marked [?]. "verafide" in the continued paragraph and "Verafides" in thesis 7 are printed without a space and are copied as printed. "fidem'ut" in thesis 13 shows a mark between the words, copied as printed. "quaesitur" in thesis 8 is hard to read at the print and may differ; the word is copied with its likely letters. The page number is printed as 245 in old-style numerals.
